title: inventory.stock
description: A snapshot of a Variant's Stock, published whenever its On-hand, its available Stock or whether it is stocked changes. Keyed by variantId.

eventId.description: Unique per event; the same event delivered twice has the same eventId.

occurredAt.description: When the change was published, in the transaction that made it.

variantId.description: The Variant's ID: the message key.

version.description: The aggregate's version, which goes up by at least one with every change. Apply an event only if it is newer than what you hold.

stocked.description: Whether Inventory keeps Stock for the Variant at all; false once it is removed.

warehouse.description: Throwaway: shows the CI compatibility check.
